wc:minerva-alert.summary: Inline status message with icon, actions, dismissal and collapse.
wc:minerva-alert.description: Important messages: system notices, operation feedback (`<Alert>` of React). Danger / warning alerts interrupt (`role="alert"`), info / success ones are polite (`role="status"`). With `closable`, the close button fires a cancelable `minerva-close`; unless prevented, focus first moves out of the alert (to `returnFocus`, else the next focusable element after it, else the previous one, else its container — never `<body>`) and the element then hides itself (`hidden` attribute; remove it from the DOM in the listener or set `hidden = false` to show it again). With `collapsible` (and a heading) a toggle in the heading expands / collapses the message.

translationResources.title: Alert
translationResources.description: Displays an important message inline, such as system notices or the result of an action.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color sets the status: info (default), success, warning and danger. It also picks the icon and the role.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant sets the visual style: subtle (default, tinted background), outline (colored border) or solid (filled with the color).

with-title.title: With title
with-title.description: Add a title above the content. showIcon={false} hides the icon.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: closable adds a close button; closeIcon replaces its icon and onClose is called on close.

with-action.title: With action
with-action.description: Render buttons or links on the right with action.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: With a title, collapsible lets users expand and collapse the content. Control it with expanded + onExpand, or set only the initial state with defaultExpanded.

banner.title: Banner
banner.description: Banner mode for notices at the top of a page.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Custom icon, elevation, the outline and solid variants and corner radius options.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose the entrance animation or turn it off.

return-focus.title: Focus after closing
return-focus.description: Closing an alert with its close button never drops focus to the page: it moves to the next focusable element after the alert (else the previous one, else its container), or to returnFocus (an element, a ref or a function).

AlertProps.title: Alert title
AlertProps.color: Semantic (status) color, which also sets the default icon and the role
AlertProps.variant: Visual style: subtle (tinted background), outline (transparent background with a colored border) or solid (filled with the color)
AlertProps.showIcon: Shows the status icon of the color
AlertProps.icon: Custom icon, replacing the status icon
AlertProps.onClose: Called when the close button is clicked
AlertProps.action: Action area rendered on the right, e.g. buttons
AlertProps.banner: Banner mode, suited to page-level notices at the top of a page
AlertProps.collapsible: Lets the content be expanded and collapsed (requires a title)
AlertProps.expanded: Whether the content is expanded (controlled); use together with onExpand
AlertProps.defaultExpanded: Whether the content is initially expanded (uncontrolled)
AlertProps.onExpand: Called with the new state when the content is expanded or collapsed
AlertProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button
AlertProps.expandLabel: Accessible label of the toggle while the content is collapsed
AlertProps.collapseLabel: Accessible label of the toggle while the content is expanded
AlertProps.iconLabel: Accessible label of the status icon
AlertProps.role: ARIA role of the alert. Danger and warning interrupt ("alert"), info and success are polite ("status")
AlertProps.returnFocus: Element receiving focus after the alert is closed with its close button: an element, a ref or a function. Without it focus moves to the next focusable element after the alert (else the previous one, else its container), never to <body>
